newsitem.title: KUWAIT: S.Korea Daelim in $128mln Kuwait oil centre deal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Daelim in $128mln Kuwait oil centre deal.

text.p: South Korea's Daelim Engineering Co Ltd said on Tuesday it won a $128 million contract to build an oil gathering centre (GC) in Kuwait.

The state "Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) signed the contract yesterday (Monday)," Daelim's Kuwait manager S.E. Oh told Reuters of the 27-month project to build gathering centre (GC) 25 which will have a 250,000 barrel per day (bpd) capacity.
In October Kuwait invited some 24 pre-qualified Western and Asian firms to participate in a tender to build crude GC 25.
Many of Kuwait's GCs were damaged during the 1991 Gulf War.

OPEC-member Kuwait, with a two million bpd oil output quota, had in December 1995 awarded China Petroleum Engineering Construstion Corporation a $391.5 million contract to build GCs 27 and 28 with a combined capacity of 410,000 bpd.

Kuwait plans to raise its production capacity to about three million bpd early in the next century from a current 2.5 million bpd. Kuwait's output peaked at more than three million bpd early in the 1970s.
